Message:
SMB3: incorrect file id in requests compounded with open

See MS-SMB2 3.2.4.1.4, file ids in compounded requests should be set to
0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF (we were treating it as u32 not u64 and setting
it incorrectly).
